paragraphs.en: {Chinese} cultural elements commemorating ( (纪念) ) Tang Xianzu, who is known as “the Shakespeare of Asia,”add an international character to Stratford-upon-Avon, William Shakespeare's {hometown} .
paragraphs.cn: 汤显祖被誉为“亚洲的莎士比亚”，纪念汤显祖的 <u> 中国 </u> 文化元素为威廉·莎士比亚的 <u> 故乡 </u> 埃文河畔的斯特拉特福增添了一抹国际色彩。

paragraphs.en: As {brilliant} {playwrights} , Tang and Shakespeare were {contemporaries} and both died in 1616.Tang was from the Ming {dynasty} in China, while Shakespeare was from {England} .Although they could never have {met} , there are common {themes} in their {fantastic} works, said Paul Edmondson, head of research for the Shakespeare {Birthplace} {Trust} .“Some of the things that Tang was writing about were also Shakespeare's {concerns} .I {happen} to know that Tang's {play} The Peony Pavilion is similar in some ways to Romeo and Juliet .”Both plays include {dramatic} storytelling ( (讲故事) ).They have had a significant impact on the {theater} and continue to {impress} {audiences} from all over the {globe} .
paragraphs.cn: 作为 <u> 杰出的剧作家 </u> ，汤显祖与莎士比亚是 <u> 同时代的人 </u> ，而且他们都于1616年过世。汤显祖来自中国的明 <u> 朝 </u> ，而莎士比亚则来自 <u> 英国 </u> 。莎士比亚 <u> 出生地信托 </u> 研究负责人保罗·埃德蒙森说，尽管二人从未 <u> 谋面 </u> ，但他们 <u> 精彩的 </u> 作品有着共同的 <u> 主题 </u> 。“汤显祖所写的一些内容也是莎士比亚所 <u> 关注 </u> 的。我 <u> 碰巧 </u> 得知，汤显祖的 <u> 剧作 </u> 《牡丹 <u> 亭 </u> 》在某些方面与《罗密欧与朱丽叶》有着相似之处。”两部剧作都采用了 <u> 戏剧性的 </u> 叙事手法。它们都对 <u> 戏剧 </u> 产生了重大影响，并仍在继续 <u> 打动 </u> 着 <u> 全球 </u> 的 <u> 观众 </u> 。

paragraphs.en: A {statue} commemorating Shakespeare and Tang was put up at Shakespeare's Birthplace Garden in 2017.Two years later, a six-meter-tall pavilion, inspired by The Peony Pavilion , was built at the Firs Garden, just ten minutes' walk from Shakespeare's birthplace.This addition not only serves to {honor} the legacy ( (遗产) ) of both playwrights but also to inspire a deeper {appreciation} for international literature among locals and {tourists} .
paragraphs.cn: 2017年，一座纪念莎士比亚和汤显祖的 <u> 雕像 </u> 在莎士比亚故居花园落成。两年后，一座受《牡丹亭》的启发而建的六米高的亭子在菲尔兹花园落成，这里距离莎士比亚故居仅十分钟的步行路程。这一增建的建筑不仅是为了 <u> 纪念 </u> 两位剧作家的文学遗产，也是为了激发当地人和 <u> 游客 </u> 对国际文学更深层次的 <u> 欣赏 </u> 。

paragraphs.en: Those cultural elements have transformed Stratford into a more engaging cultural {venue} and have increased the {town's} international {visibility} , said Edmondson.Visits to {nearby} {galleries} increased as people came to view the special {display} .Edmondson added that {visitors} walking through the Birthplace Garden were often amazed to find connections between the two great writers.
paragraphs.cn: 埃德蒙森表示，这些文化元素将斯特拉特福转变为一个更具吸引力的文化 <u> 场所 </u> ，提升了该 <u> 镇 </u> 的国际 <u> 知名度 </u> 。随着人们前来观赏这个特别 <u> 展览 </u> ， <u> 周边画廊 </u> 的参观人数也有所增加。埃德蒙森还补充说，步行穿过故居花园的 <u> 游客 </u> 常常惊讶地发现两位伟大作家之间的联系。

paragraphs.en: {Recalling} watching a Chinese {opera} version of Shakespeare's play Richard III in Shanghai, and meeting Chinese {actors} and {actresses} who came to Stratford a few years ago to perform parts of The Peony Pavilion , Edmondson said,“It was very {exciting} to hear the Chinese language and see how Tang's play was being performed.”
paragraphs.cn: 埃德蒙森 <u> 回忆 </u> 起曾在上海观看过中国戏曲版的莎士比亚 <u> 戏剧 </u> 《理查三世》，以及几年前与来到斯特拉特福表演《牡丹亭》选段的中国 <u> 演员 </u> 们见面的情景。他说：“听中文，看到汤显祖的剧作是如何被演绎的，是非常 <u> 令人兴奋的 </u> 。”

paragraphs.en: There is hope that further {arrangements} will {highlight} the shared heritage and deepen {mutual} respect, thus {enhancing} cultural ties and promoting a {harmonious} relationship between local communities.By continuing to {cooperate} on cultural projects, both countries can expect an {expansion} in their cultural exchange.
paragraphs.cn: 人们希望，进一步的活动 <u> 安排 </u> 能够 <u> 彰显 </u> 两国共同的文化遗产，加深 <u> 彼此间的 </u> 尊重，从而 <u> 加强 </u> 文化联系，促进当地社区间的 <u> 和谐 </u> 关系。通过继续在文化项目上开展 <u> 合作 </u> ，两国有望在文化交流方面取得更大的 <u> 进展 </u> 。 5NoOncib/NjiX02BpMIzP4m+378Hw1xTRxUdPaP/PFjKUFq4K2G7tp6ZLYoCE601yW1W39VMdLmovFdSHs4nVQ==
